summary: Dr. Reddy's Laboratories filed a Form 6-K on May 12, 2026, furnishing an intimation of upcoming analyst and institutional investor meetings scheduled for May 14-15, 2026 in Mumbai and May 18-19, 2026 in Singapore, organized by HSBC and Bank of America respectively. The filing contains no material corporate event, deal terms, or special situation; it is a routine disclosure of investor conference participation under SEBI listing regulations. The filing is a foreign private issuer report equivalent to a routine current report on Form 8-K for non-US companies. There are no actionable event-driven aspects.
